ip.description: This is the address of the gateway. It can be an IPv4 address like 1.1.1.1 or a fully qualified domain name like my-sip-trunk.pstn.twilio.com.

port.description:
This is the port number of the gateway. Default is 5060.

@default 5060

netmask.description:
This is the netmask of the gateway. Defaults to 32.

@default 32

inboundEnabled.description:
This is whether inbound calls are allowed from this gateway. Default is true.

@default true

outboundProtocol.description:
This is the protocol to use for SIP signaling outbound calls. Default is udp.

@default udp
